# Flows: Inspection
Flows: 41

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Accessory_Create
NODES=4; EDGES=3
1. START
2. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Inspection.Accessory as NewAccessory
3. ACTION ShowPageAction: show page Inspection.Assessory_NewEdit
4. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Assessory_Book
NODES=14; EDGES=12
1. START
2. DECISION IsStock? expression=$Accessory/AmountInStock != 0
3. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  4. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change Accessory (AmountInStock=$Accessory/AmountInStock - 1; refreshInClient=false)
  5. DECISION AmountInStock > 10? expression=$Accessory/AmountInStock > 10
  6. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    7. ACTION CommitAction: commit Accessory (refreshInClient=true, withEvents=true)
    8. END
  9. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    10. DECISION AmountInStock = 0 expression=$Accessory/AmountInStock = 0
    11. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
      12. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change Accessory (EquipmentStatus=Inspection.ENUM_Accessory_Status.Out_of_stock; refreshInClient=true)
      13. END
    14. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
      15. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change Accessory (EquipmentStatus=Inspection.ENUM_Accessory_Status.Almost_out_of_stock; refreshInClient=true)
      16. END
17. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  18. ACTION ShowMessageAction: show message (text=This assessory is currently out of stock., type=Information, blocking=true)
  19. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Assessory_Delete
NODES=4; EDGES=2
1. START
2. ACTION DeleteAction: delete Accessory (refreshInClient=true)
3. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Inspector_Save
NODES=8; EDGES=6
1. START
2. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.VAL_Inspector_Validate -> IsValid
3. DECISION valid? expression=$IsValid
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. ACTION CommitAction: commit Inspector (refreshInClient=true, withEvents=true)
  6. ACTION CloseFormAction: close page
  7. END
8. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  9. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Registration_Create

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Registration_Save
NODES=15; EDGES=13
1. START
2. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.VAL_Registration_Validate -> IsValid
3. DECISION valid? expression=$IsValid
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Administration.Account as NewAccount (Name=$Registration/UserName, Password=$Registration/Password, FullName=$Registration/FullName, Email=$Registration/EmailAddress)
  6. ACTION CloseFormAction: close page
  7. DECISION is inspector? expression=$Registration/Role = Inspection.Enum_Registration_UserRole.Inspector
  8. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    9. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve UserRole_Inspector from System.UserRole
    10. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Inspection.Inspector as NewInspector (Name=$Registration/UserName, Inspector_Account=$NewAccount)
    11. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change NewAccount (UserRoles=$UserRole_Inspector; refreshInClient=false)
    12. END
  13. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    14. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve UserRole_Manager from System.UserRole
    15. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change NewAccount (UserRoles=$UserRole_Manager; refreshInClient=false)
    16. END
17. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  18. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Report_ApplyFilters
NODES=13; EDGES=11
1. START
2. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve TaskList_Filtered from Inspection.Task
3. DECISION any tasks found according to the filter? expression=$TaskList_Filtered != empty
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. ACTION CreateListAction: CreateListAction (output=TaskList_ToCommit, entity=Inspection.Task, errorHandlingType=Rollback)
  6. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Inspection.Report as NewReport (Name='Filtered Task Report')
  7. LOOP iterate TaskList_Filtered as IteratorTask
    8. LOOP BODY
      9. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change IteratorTask (Task_Report=$NewReport; refreshInClient=false)
  10. ACTION CommitAction: commit TaskList_ToCommit (refreshInClient=false, withEvents=true)
  11. ACTION GenerateDocumentAction: GenerateDocumentAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
  12. ACTION DownloadFileAction: DownloadFileAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
  13. END
14. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  15. ACTION ShowMessageAction: show message (text=No tasks found based on these filters, type=Information, blocking=true)
  16. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Report_Generate
NODES=8; EDGES=7
1. START
2. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve TaskList_All from Inspection.Task
3. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Inspection.Report as NewReport (Name='Tasks report')
4. LOOP iterate TaskList_All as IteratorTask
  5. LOOP BODY
    6. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change IteratorTask (Task_Report=$NewReport; refreshInClient=false)
7. ACTION CommitAction: commit NewReport (refreshInClient=false, withEvents=true)
8. ACTION GenerateDocumentAction: GenerateDocumentAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
9. ACTION DownloadFileAction: DownloadFileAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
10. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Task_Create
NODES=5; EDGES=3
1. START
2. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Inspection.Task as NewTask (Created=[%CurrentDateTime%], Status=Inspection.Enum_TaskStatus.To_do, Task_InspectionItem=$InspectionItem)
3. ACTION ShowPageAction: show page Inspection.Task_NewEdit
4. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Task_Save
NODES=14; EDGES=14
1. START
2. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.VAL_Task_Validate -> IsValid
3. DECISION IsValid? expression=$IsValid
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. DECISION status is set to 'to do'? expression=$Task/Status = Inspection.Enum_TaskStatus.To_do
  6. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    7. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Notification.SUB_Notification_SendToInspector
    8. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
    9. ACTION CommitAction: commit Task (refreshInClient=true, withEvents=true)
    10. ACTION CloseFormAction: close page
    11. END
  12. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    13. DECISION task set to 'done'? expression=$Task/Status = Inspection.Enum_TaskStatus.Done
    14. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
      15. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Notification.SUB_Notification_SendToManager
      16. REF ExclusiveMerge
    17. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
      18. REF ExclusiveMerge
19. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  20. ACTION ShowMessageAction: show message (text=Please fill out the required fields., type=Information, blocking=true)
  21. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Task_SetToDone
NODES=11; EDGES=9
1. START
2. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.VAL_Task_Validate -> IsValid
3. DECISION IsValid? expression=$IsValid
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Notification.SUB_Notification_SendToManager
  6. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change Task (Status=Inspection.Enum_TaskStatus.Done; refreshInClient=true)
  7. ACTION ShowMessageAction: show message (text=Task has been set to done., type=Information, blocking=true)
  8. ACTION CloseFormAction: close page
  9. END
10. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  11. ACTION ShowMessageAction: show message (text=Please fill out the empty fields., type=Information, blocking=true)
  12. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Tool_Validate
NODES=14; EDGES=11
1. START
2. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve Booking from Inspection.Booking
3. DECISION Empty? expression=$Booking = empty
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.VAL_Tool_Validate -> IsValid
  6. DECISION IsValid? expression=$IsValid
  7. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    8. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Inspection.Booking as NewBooking (Booking_Equipment=$Tool, Date=$Tool/ReservationDate)
    9. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change Tool (refreshInClient=true)
    10. ACTION CloseFormAction: close page
    11. END
  12. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    13. END
14. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  15. ACTION ShowMessageAction: show message (text=There is already a booking for this date., type=Information, blocking=true)
  16. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.BCo_Inspector
NODES=7; EDGES=5
1. START
2. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve UserRole_Inspector from System.UserRole
3. DECISION doesn't have an account? expression=$Inspector/Inspection.Inspector_Account = empty
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. ACTION CreateObjectAction: create Administration.Account as NewAccount (FullName=$Inspector/Name, Email=$Inspector/EmailAddress, Name=$Inspector/EmailAddress, Password='Mendix123456', UserRoles=$UserRole_Inspector, Inspector_Account=$Inspector)
  6. END
7. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  8. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.SE_Equipment_OrderNew
NODES=9; EDGES=8
1. START
2. ACTION RetrieveAction: retrieve EquipmentList from Inspection.Equipment
3. ACTION CreateListAction: CreateListAction (output=AccessoryList, entity=Inspection.Accessory, errorHandlingType=Rollback)
4. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.SUB_Equipment_Cast
5. ACTION ListOperationAction: ListOperationAction (output=NewAccessoryList, errorHandlingType=Rollback)
6. ACTION ListOperationAction: ListOperationAction (output=NewAccessoryListToOrder, errorHandlingType=Rollback)
7. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.SUB_Accessory_Order
8. ACTION CommitAction: commit NewAccessoryListToOrder (refreshInClient=false, withEvents=true)
9. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.SUB_Accessory_Order
NODES=5; EDGES=2
1. START
2. LOOP iterate AccessoryListToOrder as IteratorAccessory
  3. LOOP BODY
    4. DECISION AmountInStock = 0? expression=$IteratorAccessory/AmountInStock = 0
    5. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change IteratorAccessory (AmountInStock=$IteratorAccessory/AmountInStock + 5, EquipmentStatus=Inspection.ENUM_Accessory_Status.In_Stock; refreshInClient=false)
    6. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change IteratorAccessory (AmountInStock=10, EquipmentStatus=Inspection.ENUM_Accessory_Status.In_Stock; refreshInClient=false)
7. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.SUB_Equipment_Cast
NODES=5; EDGES=2
1. START
2. LOOP iterate EquipmentList as IteratorEquipment
  3. LOOP BODY
    4. DECISION split IteratorEquipment
    5. ACTION ChangeListAction: change AccessoryList (type=Add, value=$Accessory)
    6. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
    7. ACTION CastAction: CastAction (output=Accessory, errorHandlingType=Rollback)
    8. NODE ContinueEvent: ContinueEvent
9. END

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.VAL_Inspector_Validate
NODES=28; EDGES=32
1. START
2. ACTION CreateVariableAction: create variable IsValid=true
3. DECISION Is Name not empty? expression=trim($Inspector/Name) != ''
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
  6. DECISION Is Telephone not empty? expression=trim($Inspector/Telephone) != ''
  7. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    8. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
    9. DECISION Is Email address not empty? expression=trim($Inspector/EmailAddress) != ''
    10. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
      11. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
      12. DECISION Is Location not empty? expression=trim($Inspector/Location) != ''
      13. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
        14. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
        15. DECISION Is Country not empty? expression=trim($Inspector/Country) != ''
        16. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
          17. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
          18. DECISION Is level not empty? expression=$Inspector/Level != empty
          19. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
            20. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
            21. END
          22. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
            23. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
            24. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
            25. REF ExclusiveMerge
        26. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
          27. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
          28. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
          29. REF ExclusiveMerge
      30. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
        31. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
        32. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
        33. REF ExclusiveMerge
    34. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
      35. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
      36. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
      37. REF ExclusiveMerge
  38. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    39. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
    40. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
    41. REF ExclusiveMerge
42. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  43. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
  44. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
  45. REF ExclusiveMerge

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.VAL_Registration_Validate
NODES=29; EDGES=32
1. START
2. ACTION CreateVariableAction: create variable IsValid=true
3. DECISION Is full name not empty? expression=trim($Registration/FullName) != ''
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
  6. DECISION Is email address not empty? expression=trim($Registration/EmailAddress) != ''
  7. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    8. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
    9. DECISION Is User name not empty? expression=trim($Registration/UserName) != ''
    10. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
      11. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
      12. DECISION Is Password not empty? expression=trim($Registration/Password) != ''
      13. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
        14. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
        15. DECISION Is Role not empty? expression=$Registration/Role != empty
        16. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
          17. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
          18. DECISION do passwords match? expression=$Registration/Password = $Registration/ConfirmPassword
          19. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
            20. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
            21. END
          22. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
            23. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
            24. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
            25. REF ExclusiveMerge
        26. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
          27. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
          28. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
          29. REF ExclusiveMerge
      30. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
        31. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
        32. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
        33. REF ExclusiveMerge
    34. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
      35. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
      36. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
      37. REF ExclusiveMerge
  38. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    39. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
    40. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
    41. REF ExclusiveMerge
42. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  43. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
  44. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
  45. REF ExclusiveMerge

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.VAL_Task_Validate
NODES=34; EDGES=40
1. START
2. ACTION CreateVariableAction: create variable IsValid=true
3. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.DS_UserRole_GetFromCurrentUser -> UserRole
4. DECISION user role manager or admin? expression=$UserRole/Name = 'Manager' or $UserRole/Name = 'Administrator'
5. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  6. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
  7. DECISION Is Title not empty?
  8. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    9. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
    10. DECISION Is Description not empty? expression=trim($Task/Description) != ''
    11. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
      12. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
      13. DECISION Is Priority not empty? expression=$Task/Priority != empty
      14. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
        15. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
        16. DECISION Is Created on not empty? expression=$Task/Created != empty
        17. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
          18. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
          19. DECISION Is Status not empty? expression=$Task/Status != empty
          20. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
            21. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
            22. DECISION Is Due date not empty? expression=$Task/DueDate != empty
            23. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
              24. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
              25. END
            26. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
              27. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
              28. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
              29. REF ExclusiveMerge
          30. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
            31. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
            32. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
            33. REF ExclusiveMerge
        34. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
          35. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
          36. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
          37. REF ExclusiveMerge
      38. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
        39. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
        40. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
        41. REF ExclusiveMerge
    42. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
      43. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
      44. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
      45. REF ExclusiveMerge
  46. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    47. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
    48. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
    49. REF ExclusiveMerge
50. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  51. DECISION Is remarks not empty? expression=trim($Task/AdditionalRemarks) != ''
  52. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    53. REF ExclusiveMerge
  54. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    55. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
    56. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
    57. REF ExclusiveMerge

FLOW Microflow: Inspection.VAL_Tool_Validate

2. ACTION CreateVariableAction: create variable IsValid=true
3. DECISION ReservationDate filled? expression=$Tool/ReservationDate != empty
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
  6. DECISION ReservationDate valid? expression=$Tool/ReservationDate >= [%CurrentDateTime%]
  7. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true

    9. END
  10. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false

  15. ACTION ChangeVariableAction: change variable IsValid=false
  16. ACTION ValidationFeedbackAction: ValidationFeedbackAction (errorHandlingType=Rollback)
  17. REF ExclusiveMerge

FLOW Rule: Inspection.RUL_Task_Title_Validate
NODES=5; EDGES=3
1. START
2. DECISION Title filled? expression=trim($Task/Title) != ''
